result.summary: The image shows a large, multi-lane intersection that is highly hostile to pedestrians, lacking any visible sidewalks, marked crosswalks, or pedestrian signals. The vast expanse of asphalt and wide turning radii prioritize high-speed vehicle movement over pedestrian safety and accessibility.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: Complete absence of marked crosswalks, sidewalks, and pedestrian signals at a large intersection.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time exposed to traffic without any refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across all legs of the intersection.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Construct raised islands in the center of the roadway to reduce crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Sidewalk and Curb Ramp Construction
interventions.description: Build paved sidewalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps to provide a continuous and accessible pedestrian path.

result.summary: The intersection features marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals across a wide, multi-lane arterial road. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long crossing distance and lack of physical refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure to high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least six lanes of traffic, significantly increasing their time of exposure to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the width of Academy Rd

hazards.name: Lack of Physical Refuge
hazards.description: The center of the roadway lacks a raised refuge island, leaving pedestrians vulnerable if they cannot complete the crossing in one cycle.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection along the crosswalk path

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised concrete island in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area and reduce effective crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to provide pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a sidewalk that is interrupted by a wide, unmarked gas station driveway. The lack of defined crossing points and the expansive paved area for vehicles create significant conflict zones for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Driveway
hazards.description: The gas station entrance creates a large, undefined area where vehicles cross the pedestrian path without clear markings or priority.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and midground where the sidewalk meets the gas station apron.

hazards.name: Poor Sidewalk Maintenance
hazards.description: Cracks and significant weed growth in the sidewalk joints create potential trip hazards and indicate neglect.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large signage and utility poles near the driveway entrance may partially block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image near the utility pole and gas station sign.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the driveway to the minimum necessary for vehicle access, using curbs to clearly define the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Paint a high-visibility crosswalk across the driveway to signal to drivers that they are crossing a pedestrian zone.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Vegetation Removal
interventions.description: Repair the cracked pavement and remove weeds to provide a smooth, accessible walking surface.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and curb ramps with tactile paving, providing basic accessibility. However, the wide four-lane crossing lacks a pedestrian refuge island and visible pedestrian-specific signals, creating a high-exposure environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic in a single stage without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and reduce exposure.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information and improve safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
